Publish.LongDescription:
Stops personal cars and motorcycles from choosing ordinary street parking across the whole city.
## Features - Enabled by default with an Options toggle. - Parking lots, parking buildings, and parking included with buildings remain available. - Does not delete cars or affect bicycle parking.
## Good to know - Existing street cars leave when used again. This can take several in-game months. Vanilla road upgrades that remove street parking clear the affected road faster. - A few cars may briefly remain after road construction while the game updates parking lanes and paths. - If parking is insufficient, CS2 handles the overflow normally, including outside-connection storage. - Safe to remove: the restriction is not stored permanently, so eligible streets return to vanilla parking.
## Support and Feedback - Please consider using the like button if the mod is useful. - Feedback and pull requests are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links.
